title: Charan Rathore's work galaxy
note: Curated semantic links. Connections explain an idea or a theme, not a dependency or collaboration. Public forks alone do not prove upstream contributions.

nodes.label: IntelliRAG
nodes.idea: An answer should show the passages behind it, and make failure visible when the evidence is thin.
nodes.method: RAG platform with async pipelines, chunking strategies, RAGAS evaluation and workers.

nodes.label: memoRABLE
nodes.idea: Keep the original lines near the output so context survives the move from document to publication.
nodes.method: Source-linked document memory, local-first with optional AI.

nodes.label: ThermoSense
nodes.idea: A forecast improves when it meets rooftop measurements, bias checks and an inspectable leaderboard.
nodes.method: Hyperlocal temperature forecasting and model/API bias tracking.

nodes.label: Systris
nodes.idea: Make a body of work explorable: follow a question to the decisions and evidence that shaped a project.
nodes.method: This Tetris portfolio is built in Next.js and exposes project/source links.

nodes.label: RAGAS checks
nodes.idea: Document tradeoffs and failure cases before calling a system reliable.
nodes.method: IntelliRAG includes an eval directory and RAGAS evaluation; the portfolio links a scientific extraction study.

nodes.label: Zeolite study
nodes.idea: Compare prompting strategies against the same extraction task rather than trusting a polished demo.
nodes.method: Zeolite synthesis event extraction study, arXiv 2512.15312.

nodes.label: magpie
nodes.idea: Work on the edges where model choice, accounts and actual software behavior meet.
nodes.method: Public fork of an agent model gateway; inspect contributions through GitHub.

nodes.label: CopilotKit
nodes.idea: Agent interfaces need state that survives updates without hiding what happened.
nodes.method: Public CopilotKit fork and contribution history.

nodes.label: openmuse
nodes.idea: Explore agent work that continues through tools, browser state and the user interface.

nodes.label: vLLM
nodes.idea: Understand the serving layer behind fast model experiences.

nodes.label: llama.cpp
nodes.idea: Follow the practical constraints of local model inference, not only the model output.

nodes.label: MiQ
nodes.idea: Connect signals to a decision in the market context where they matter.
nodes.method: Current analyst role in MENA markets, as listed in the portfolio résumé.

nodes.label: Shared board
nodes.idea: A shared board for the messy middle.

nodes.label: Finance agents
nodes.idea: Agent research with visible confidence checks.

nodes.label: Wildlife vision
nodes.method: Object detection from drone footage repository.

nodes.label: CAD bolt data
nodes.idea: Generate the shape and label together.

nodes.label: Flipkart
nodes.idea: Seller-funnel behavior became pipelines and dashboards for product decisions.
nodes.method: Product Analyst Intern role listed in the portfolio résumé.
